scope: An instance of the Becoming core's law of listed masses in CorrectionDependence's draws on one shared stock. The first n draws listed latest first are a domain, a selection is an event on it and the draws are its weighting: the selected total is the selection's mass and the total the whole domain's. So every selection fits within the stock exactly when the total does (every_selection_within_iff_total_within, from every_event_within_iff), and two draws of two each fitting a stock of two do not fit it together (each_within_alone_not_together, the whole domain's mass four). What a draw and the stock stand for keeps CorrectionDependence's scope; correspondence to actual activities and stocks is not checked.
